d:
"Tumne Pukara Aur Hum Chale Aaye" is a captivating song from the Bollywood classic "Rajkumar" (1964), starring the charismatic Shammi Kapoor and the graceful Sadhana. Sung by the legendary Mohammed Rafi, this track is a timeless melody that exudes charm and romance.
Tumne Pukara Aur Hum Chale Aaye | Mohammed Rafi | Rajkumar (1964) | Shammi Kapoor, Sadhana
Song : Tumne Pukara Aur Hum Chale
Movie : Rajkumar (1964)
Singer : Mohammed Rafi, Suman Kalyanpur
Cast : Shammi Kapoor, Sadhana, Pran, Om Prakash, Rajendranath
Music : Shankar Jaikishan
Lyrics : Hasrat Jaipuri
